messages:
Noah (AE): Quick ask — Global payments customer wants a hosted POC with a live load demo. Need a temporary QPS increase to 250 for a 36h window and IP allowlist. They also want scoped keys and proof of rotation.
Sumi (Solutions): Hosted scoped keys + temp quota bucket is standard. We can stamp qps=250 on the scoped token and isolate usage in demos/<cust>-<date>. Scoped keys can have TTL; recommend 4h session tokens + a 36h ops token.
Eli (SRE): We need their egress NAT CIDRs. If they use ephemeral runners, get the runner pool ranges. Ops will add CIDRs to the frontend ACL and tag the token for logs.
Noah (AE): Client will provide a small set of NAT ranges. I'll chase and post by EOD. Any limit on per-key qps?
Sumi (Solutions): Per-key QPS up to 500 for short windows; we'll attach a temporary quota bucket so it won't affect global limits. Add meta tags: customer_id, demo_id, owner.
Eli (SRE): Monitoring: enable token-level metrics and set alert: p95 > 400ms OR error_rate > 1% for 5m. We'll run a 10m smoke at 50% of target before go-time. Auto-revoke at TTL end.
compliance-bot: For rotation proof, attach the scoped-key audit log and our rotation policy link: https://redwood.example.com/security/keys. I can auto-fill the questionnaire entry once token IDs are provided.
Sumi (Solutions): Example internal call we use (ops will run): POST /internal/keys {parent:"sk-live-xxx", qps:250, ttl_seconds:14400, allowed_cidrs:["203.0.113.0/24"], bucket:"demos/payments-2026-03"} -> returns token + id.
Noah (AE): Great. Target provision Thursday 09:00 PT. I'll post CIDRs and the primary contact. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Eli (SRE): Queued ACL change. Approve once CIDRs land. Will attach smoke test results and set auto-revoke.
Sumi (Solutions): I'll create the demo bucket and template the scoped-key response for the customer runbook.
